classification_note: CONFIRMED describes repository behavior at the reviewed commit, not a new official permission or live verification.

prior_blocker_assessments.confirmed: Canonical SHA-256 uses a domain prefix and sorted unique opaque identifiers. Both render and click recompute the digest; duplicate identifiers and mismatched digests are rejected.
prior_blocker_assessments.remaining: The expected digest remains caller supplied. Neither entry point nor inert integration binds it to the PR #280/#281 reviewed ten-item selection. No evidence connects the new canonical encoding to that selection reference.

prior_blocker_assessments.confirmed: One observation dictionary carries the clicked opaque identifier, resolved content identifier, timestamp, status and response. The click identifier must match; exactly one matching response item is required and the transient affiliateURL is extracted only from that item.
prior_blocker_assessments.remaining: The dictionary supplies its own resolved identity and timestamp. The integration does not obtain or verify the opaque-to-content mapping from the trusted resolver or establish that the response was obtained for this click. Consistently relabelling the supplied resolved identity and response still succeeds.

prior_blocker_assessments.confirmed: The offline renderer emits rel="noopener noreferrer sponsored" on the same-origin opaque CTA link.

fixed_cta.value: 公式商品ページを見る（外部サイト）

proximate_pr_disclosure.value: PR：このリンクはアフィリエイトリンクです。リンク先で購入された場合、DATA LABが報酬を受け取ることがあります。
proximate_pr_disclosure.placement: Immediately preceding the CTA in the same article; both absent for ineligible render records.

render_and_click_freshness.detail: Nonnegative age up to and including 15 minutes is accepted. Future or older observations fail closed. This internal bound does not prove a new API request occurred at click time.

fail_closed.scope: Checked input conditions only; unresolved selection and observation provenance are excluded.
fail_closed.detail: Invalid or duplicate selection, digest mismatch, stale/future observation, error/rate-limit status, absent/multiple exact matches and missing/unsafe affiliate URL block the applicable candidate. Invalid render contracts raise without returning HTML; stale/error render records omit the CTA.

exact_single_item_semantics.detail: Exactly one matching item is enforced, not a response containing exactly one total item. Additional unmatched items are accepted; this is recorded as a contract distinction, not an independent blocker.

url_nonexposure.detail: Offline HTML contains only the opaque same-origin route. Click and integration receipts expose no identifiers, affiliate URL or Location. No actual redirect is emitted.

fresh_api_before_render.detail: Render evaluates caller-supplied freshness and status; the reviewed integration does not establish observation provenance.

production_and_official_status.detail: No production endpoint, D1, DMM/FANZA API or official permission was rechecked. Repository comparison shows no public HTML or deployment configuration changes from the prior reviewed main.

minimum_follow_up: Connect the canonical digest to the reviewed exact ten-item selection through a trusted approval context. Record the canonicalization version and sanitized migration evidence if the reference digest encoding changes; reject replacement of both set and digest outside that context.

At the integration boundary, obtain the opaque-to-content mapping and click observation through the trusted resolver/fetch chain, binding the returned item and transient URL to that result. Verify the chain offline with injected fakes; do not activate a live connector during remediation review.
Retain the fixed CTA, adjacent disclosure, rel tokens, internal freshness bound, fail-closed outputs and false activation flags.
